summary: Escambia County lookout run by the Alabama Forestry Commission; a 2006 entry says it was sold as surplus and moved to Butler County.

facts.status_note: Declared surplus and sold to a private party in 2006, then moved to a site in Butler County, according to one lookout-site page.

events.note: The page's 2006 entry says the tower was declared surplus, sold to a private party, and then moved to a site in Butler County. The entry gives no date for the move.

notes_for_editor: Only one page names this tower and its 2006 history (Eastern U.S. Lookouts). It dates the surplus sale to 2006 but gives no date for the move, and it names neither the buyer nor the Butler County site. The record point (31.18327, -87.46463) lies in Escambia County; it is not verified as the original site. TopoQuest lists a Chapman Lookout Tower in Butler County (N31.694879 W86.686918, 383 ft). No source ties it to Huxford, so it is not used. Status is set to relocated from the 2006 entry; the record says 'unknown'. No correction proposed, since the record's county and agency match the page. Confidence medium: a single source, with an undated move.
